notes.title: Hitman GO: Definitive Edition coming to Steam next week
notes.content:
The award-winning turn-based strategy game Hitman GO will launch on February 23rd and will be priced at $7.99 / €7.99 / £6.49

For those wondering, the Steam version of Hitman GO will feature Steam Cloud, Steam Trading Cards, Steam Achievements and full controller support. 

Until then, we’ll be in the forums answering your questions about the game.

Talk to you soon!

- Nicolas Verge, Community Manager at Square Enix Montreal
